AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.paragraph_1: You've definitely experienced it: you need to upload a photo to an official portal, an application, or a website, but you hit an uncompromising 5 MB limit. Modern smartphones take photos in amazing quality, but the resulting files are often too „heavy“ for today's internet. For many, finding a way to resize a photo without losing sharpness is an unnecessary technical hurdle.
AboutPage.paragraph_2: That’s exactly why Resize-King was created a tool that intelligently and quickly solves the problem of strict website limits.
AboutPage.paragraph_3: This entire project is designed as a „one-click“ solution for everyone.
AboutPage.list_text_1: Simplicity without compromise: You don't need to be a tech expert. Just insert your file and Resize-King takes care of the rest directly in your browser, safely and privately (files never leave your device and are not uploaded to a server).
